title: Two information-set scans for a 104-bit block product

claims.statement: The explicit concatenation of 19 length-104 dimension-52 extended cyclic blocks and one extended Golay block in proof.md, decoded by the two order-six information-set scans and chosen-leader Golay tail, has uniform-message average block error at most 499158619027849817/500000000000000000 on the memoryless BSC(1/10) in 2000 channel uses for 1000 message bits.
The word-RAM program in proof.md for the same explicit code and decoder uses at most W=13253472238 bsc-ops-v1 operations on every received word, with W <= 2^(16813/500).

experiments.purpose: Verify the two systematic bases, orthogonality, generators of the projective coordinate action, and the complete low systematic weight distance search. Derive the exact spectrum, cumulative collision lower bound for correct decoding, tail histogram, error fraction, memory and operations certificate.
